rust_summary: claiming the disconnected screen after connection teardown (`native_client_disconnected`).
doc_summary: `client_disconnected(reason, key, from_server)` receives the original disconnect context after teardown and returns `Flow::Cancel` to claim the screen. A claim keeps the title screen instead of Disconnected and suppresses reconnect UI; it never cancels teardown. Intentional leave and transfer do not notify. With no claim the existing screen and reconnect path remain. This is disconnect-specific, not the general screen-opening proposal #7277. Requires native hooks API @API:client_disconnected@.
